min_standing_note.value: Must have completed at least two terms of full-time study at home institution prior to exchange and must not be in the final year or final semester at home institution.

min_gpa_host.notes: Requires cumulative GPA of 2.5 or higher on a 4.0 scale (matches Lingnan University.docx).

instruction_languages.notes: Lingnan conducts approximately 75% of classes in English.

english_course_availability.notes: Approx. 75% of classes taught in English across Arts, Business, and Social Sciences.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: Non-native English speakers must provide proof: TOEFL iBT 79 (CBT 213 / PBT 550), IELTS Academic 6.0 overall, TOEIC 750 + support letter, or TOEFL ITP 550 + support letter. RHET 1020 / English-medium waiver not explicitly stated in Fall 2025 PDF.

host_language_requirement.value: English proficiency scores required for non-native English speakers (no Chinese/Cantonese requirement for English-taught courses).

fall_term_dates.value: Fall 2026 (Term 1): Classes begin Sep 1, 2026; Classes end Nov 30, 2026; Examinations Dec 8-19, 2026.

spring_term_dates.value: Spring 2027 (Term 2): Classes begin Jan 11, 2027; Classes end Apr 20, 2027; Examinations Apr 28 - May 11, 2027.

final_semester_allowed.notes: Fall 2025 PDF p.1 states: 'must not be in their final year or final semester at their home institution.'

tuition_model.notes: Incoming exchange students under reciprocal agreements have tuition waived by Lingnan University and continue paying home tuition.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Live Lingnan OGE portal estimates ~HKD 6,700/month in living expenses (meals HKD 3,500 + transport HKD 1,200 + entertainment/personal HKD 2,000), excluding on-campus hostel fee (~HKD 8,200 + HKD 330 air-con per term unless waived). Earlier 2020/21 Lingnan.docx estimated HKD 4,800-6,700/month.

living_cost_usd_est.notes: 6,700 HKD/month * 5 months = 33,500 HKD; converted at ECB 2026-11-13 rate (collected 2026-11-15) 1 EUR = 8.6714 HKD & 1 EUR = 1.1052 USD -> 1 HKD = 0.12745347 USD (https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html) = 4,269.69 USD (excludes hostel HKD 8,530/term if not waived).

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Tuition fees waived under bilateral exchange. Mandatory on-campus twin-sharing hostel fee (~HKD 8,200/term + HKD 330 air-con/term) applies unless waived under institutional agreement. Comprehensive health/travel insurance recommended/required for study in Hong Kong.

housing_availability.notes: All incoming exchange students are required to live on campus in twin-sharing student hostel rooms.

housing_notes.value: Mandatory twin-sharing on-campus hostel rooms; approx. HKD 8,200/term hostel fee + HKD 330/term air-conditioning fee (waived under some partner agreements).

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Students must obtain a Hong Kong Student Visa/Entry Permit before studying at Lingnan by completing the HKSAR VISA/ENTRY Permit Application Form and returning printed signed forms/documents by the deadline (Apr 30 for Fall) via courier for OGE sponsorship.
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.notes: Hard-copy courier submission deadline & address detailed on p.3.

english_course_list_url.notes: Approx. 75% of classes are taught in English; consult Term Course Offering List.

credit_system_and_load.value: Full-time HKSAR student visa status requires 12-18 undergraduate credits per term (normal load 15-18 credits; max 18 credits/term and 33 credits/year).

course_restrictions_note.value: Exchange students may take undergraduate courses across faculties subject to prerequisites and major restrictions; online course registration is first-come, first-served (tentatively July for Fall).

value: Printed/hard-copy signed application package & VISA/ENTRY Permit form sent by courier
Recommendation letter in English from home faculty or International Office
Official transcript & endorsement from home institution
required_application_docs.notes: Courier hard-copy checklist detailed on p.2-3.

campus_type.notes: Located at 8 Castle Peak Road, Tuen Mun, New Territories, Hong Kong (no explicit urban/suburban schema label on official portal).

international_support_services.value: Office of Global Education (OGE, exchange@LN.edu.hk) coordinates student visa sponsorship, pre-arrival support, and on-campus hostel placement; CEAL offers English/additional language support.

nomination_deadlines.value: Fall Term / Full Year: Deadline April 30 (incl. hard-copy courier documents). Spring (2nd) Term: Deadline October 15.
nomination_deadlines.notes: Fall Apr 30 online + paper courier deadline also stated in data/raw/factsheets/Lingnan University/Lingnan University_Student Exchange Programme_Fall 2025__1ZXGSg.pdf#page=1, #page=3.
